# Flow Slice Template — Business Flow Mapper Output
# ============================================================
# Generated by: Flow Mapper agent
# One file per identified flow. Saved to specs/flows/FLOW-{N}-{name}.md
# ============================================================

flow_id: "FLOW-{N}-{flow-type-name}"
flow_type: "deposit | withdraw | mint_burn | redemption | liquidation | claim_reward | settlement | bridge_message | oracle_update | admin_config"
protocol: "{protocol name}"
economic_risk_score: 0.0   # 0.0–1.0 (set by Flow Mapper after analysis)

# ── Actors ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

initiator: "user | resolver | keeper | governance | anyone | bridge"

trusted_roles_required:
  - role: "{role name}"
    contract: "{contract}"
    function: "{function}"
    note: "{why this role is needed}"
  # Empty if no trusted role required

external_callers:
  - contract: "{external contract name}"
    address_known: true
    call_type: "token_transfer | external_call | delegatecall | staticcall"
    note: "{reentrancy risk? oracle read?}"

# ── Execution Path ───────────────────────────────────────────

entry_point:
  contract: "{ContractName}"
  function: "{functionName}()"
  visibility: "public | external"

call_sequence:
  - step: 1
    contract: "{ContractName}"
    function: "{functionName}()"
    note: ""
  - step: 2
    contract: "{ContractName}"
    function: "{functionName}()"
    note: "⚠️ external call — reentrancy surface"
  - step: 3
    contract: "{ExternalContract}"
    function: "transfer()"
    note: "ERC20 transfer to user"

# ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

entry_state:
  - "{state variable} == {required value}"
  - "vault.paused == false"

exit_state:
  - "{state variable} updated to {expected value}"
  - "user.balance reduced by amount"

state_variables_changed:
  - name: "{variableName}"
    contract: "{ContractName}"
    direction: "increase | decrease | reset | set"
    note: ""

# ── Assets ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

assets_moved:
  - token: "{token name or ETH}"
    direction: "in | out | both"
    from: "{from address/contract}"
    to: "{to address/contract}"
    amount: "user-specified | calculated | fixed"

assets_at_risk:
  - token: "{token name}"
    contract: "{holding contract}"
    approximate_usd: "$0"
    risk: "theft | loss | lock"

# ── Invariants This Flow Must Preserve ───────────────────────

invariants:
  - id: "INV-{N}"
    statement: "{formal invariant}"
    criticality: "Critical | High | Medium"
    note: ""

# ── Risk Surface ─────────────────────────────────────────────

reentrancy_surfaces:
  - step: {N}
    type: "ETH_transfer | ERC20_transfer | external_call | ERC777_callback"
    guarded: true   # nonReentrant present?
    note: ""

oracle_reads:
  - contract: "{oracle contract}"
    function: "{function}"
    staleness_check: true
    twap_or_spot: "twap | spot"
    note: ""

caller_controlled_params:
  - param: "{parameter name}"
    type: "{uint256 | address | bytes}"
    constraints: "{none | bounded by X | validated by Y}"

# ── Task Generation Hints ─────────────────────────────────────
# These are NOT tasks — they are hints for the Threat Modeler

potential_failure_modes:
  - mode: "reentrancy during {step N}"
    attacker_entry: "{function}"
    estimated_priority: "Critical | High | Medium"

  - mode: "share price manipulation via {mechanism}"
    attacker_entry: "{function}"
    estimated_priority: "High"

# ── Flags ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

flags:
  ambiguous_state_transition: false    # ⚠️ set true if entry/exit state unclear
  cross_contract_state_risk: false     # state consistency across 2+ contracts
  no_reentrancy_guard: false           # external call without nonReentrant
  oracle_staleness_unchecked: false    # oracle read without timestamp check
  notes: ""
